sample_selection: Distinct WHSK swap blocks from swaps.csv, sorted by block number. Select indices floor(i*497/23), i=0..23. Fork at the end of each selected block.
benchmark: Reset the fork for A-first and B-first DEX sequences and the 400 WHSK residual sale. Each trader is compared to their most favorable outcome from the two DEX sequences.
settlement_model: Hypothetical ordered parties. A sells 1000 WHSK for at least 81 USDT, B buys 600 WHSK for at most 49.2 USDT, 600 direct plus 400 residual through HSKSwap. Service fee zero. A pays the full assumed incremental network cost relative to DEX; B gets no credit for avoided gas. No matching transactions were broadcast.
equal_gains_definition: Both gains positive, absolute difference at most one micro-USDT.

separate_rpc_header_check.note: The other header requests received HTTP 429. Fork trials also check their requested block number.

receipt_crosscheck.selection: 12 unique WHSK swap transactions at floor(i*655/11) in the source CSV's 656 WHSK rows.
receipt_crosscheck.note: Observed costs of pre-existing DEX swap transactions. Mixed-settlement incremental gas and approvals remain unmeasured.
